P18 fenced outbox relay run-once: db/metaframer_kernel_db/outbox_relay.py's run_outbox_relay_once(sqlalchemy_url, tenant_id, deliver, *, limit, lease_seconds) — no defaults on limit/lease_seconds, both required keyword-only — composes the existing S1 substrate's claim_batch/publish_claim/release_claim primitives into one single-pass drain: claims up to limit rows under a lease in its own transaction, offers each row to the caller-supplied deliver callback, and in a second, fresh transaction per outcome calls publish_claim on a True return and release_claim (not a plain retry) on any falsy return or raised exception, fencing a stale claimant's late token to zero rows; returns a frozen OutboxRelayResult(published, failed) — two id tuples, no remaining/count field; test-verified against real PostgreSQL 16 across 3 scenarios (db/tests/test_outbox_relay_lifecycle.py, PR #122 with a passing CI run) — a clean drain publishes every row and a second call finds nothing left, a failed delivery is released (not published) and the same id stays retryable, and a stale claimant's late token is fenced after the relay reclaims and publishes; run-once only, no scheduler, no retry-interval loop, no dead-letter queue, no live entrypoint/host wiring, no production/release claim

P19 observed outbox relay SLO: db/metaframer_kernel_db/observability.py's run_observed_outbox_relay_once wraps P18's run_outbox_relay_once with a RelaySlo threshold and emits exactly one structured outbox_relay.batch_completed event per call carrying batch duration and failure-rate measurements plus a RelaySlo verdict (green/red on duration and on failure-rate independently), test-verified against real PostgreSQL 16 across exactly 3 scenarios (db/tests/test_outbox_relay_observability_slo.py, PR #124 with a passing CI run 32970268485) — a clean drain and a second empty pass are both SLO green, a partial failure preserves P18's publish/release outcomes and goes failure-rate red without leaking exception detail, and a deterministically slow but fully successful drain is only latency red; single-pass observed run only, no exporter, no dashboard, no alert transport, no scheduler/consumer-loop/retry policy/DLQ around the relay, no live entrypoint/host wiring, no production/release claim

P20 performance baseline: db/metaframer_kernel_db/performance.py's summarize_relay_performance(samples) computes a deterministic, ambient-clock-free RelayPerformanceBaseline over caller-supplied RelayPerformanceSample values — nearest-rank p95/p99 duration seconds, published/failed totals, summed measured wall_clock_seconds and a seconds_per_published proxy, a sorted per-tenant p95 breakdown, and a measured fairness_ratio (min/max tenant p95) — test-verified against real PostgreSQL 16 across exactly 3 scenarios (db/tests/test_outbox_relay_performance_baseline.py, PR #126 with a passing CI run 32982906594); pure summarization only, no calibrated SLA/threshold, no scheduler, retry, DLQ, exporter, dashboard, live host, optimizer, load generator or dollar-cost claim

P21A host trusted-identity boundary: host/js_asgi/create_customer_asgi_runner.mjs's real-database ALLOW path now takes its authenticated Principal only from explicit trusted process inputs (--trusted-tenant-id, --trusted-actor-id), so a request's own identity headers are checkable claims instead of being the identity itself, and a malformed or missing trusted input fails closed before any database is contacted; test-verified against real PostgreSQL 16 (tests/kernel-python-host-bridge-real-pg-allow.test.mjs, PR #128 with a passing CI run 32997140154)

P21B boundary authorization deny zero-write proof: the boundary's authorization deny path is proven against a real PostgreSQL 16 substrate to write nothing — the closed default deny with no candidate, and an applicable deny against an applicable allow in either order, are refused before the invariant stage while the three write tables are counted whole-database with no tenant filter and stay untouched, and a positive control on the same substrate proves those zero-write results are a refused write rather than a harness that could not write; test-verified (tests/kernel-create-customer-asgi-composition.test.mjs, PR #129 with a passing CI run 33003288720)

P21C boundary decision audit: every authorization decision the boundary reaches is appended to the append-only, hash-chained policy_decision_log on a real PostgreSQL 16 substrate before that decision can reach the invariant stage or any commit — the closed default deny lands as an independently verifiable genesis entry, the allow chains onto it by prev_hash, a decision that cannot be logged stops the request instead of committing unaudited, src/application/create-customer-pipeline.mjs admits exactly the two decision-point prototypes by prototype identity plus a frozen zero-own-property structural check (explicitly not a private brand), and one close releases both runtime pools the audited composition owns; test-verified (tests/kernel-boundary-decision-audit-p21c.test.mjs, PR #130 with a passing CI run 33010709401)

P21D audited ASGI boundary composition: src/delivery/create-customer-asgi-composition.mjs's additive createAuditedCustomerAsgiComposition wires the P21C audited handler through the same http message adapter, one-route router and ASGI core profile adapter, so against a real PostgreSQL 16 substrate the closed default deny answers the protocol boundary only after landing as an independently verifiable genesis entry in the hash-chained policy_decision_log with no business row anywhere, the allow commits with its canonical CommitReceipt chained on by prev_hash, and a decision that cannot be logged can never produce a 2xx at the boundary; the unaudited createCustomerAsgiComposition keeps its exact contract, no host is selected and no server is started; test-verified (tests/kernel-audited-asgi-boundary-composition-p21d.test.mjs, PR #131 with a passing CI run 33015412681)

P21E identity-guard decision audit: CreateCustomerPipeline admits one optional, strictly descriptor-validated auditIdentityGuard witness awaited after a genuine identity guard refusal and before that refusal is returned, and src/delivery/create-customer-composition.mjs's createAuditedCustomerComposition injects a durable one over the same decision log, id generator, clock and chain head the audited policy decision point already uses — against real PostgreSQL 16 a cross-tenant claim is the hash-chained log's independently verifiable genesis, an actor mismatch chains onto it under its own distinct reason, a double mismatch is recorded as the cross-tenant refusal, every such row is filed under the authenticated identity with no attacker-claimed tenant or actor surviving in any column of any of the four tables, and a guard deny that cannot be recorded rejects instead of answering an unrecorded 403; test-verified (tests/kernel-identity-guard-decision-audit-p21e.test.mjs, PR #132 with a passing CI run 33019320390)

P21F audited host runner: launched with --policy allow --audit on, host/js_asgi/create_customer_asgi_runner.mjs composes the audited boundary, mints its own canonical ULIDs and its own UTC-millisecond instants, and appends every policy decision and every identity-guard refusal it reaches to the append-only, hash-chained policy_decision_log before the invariant stage or any commit, refusing to answer at all when it cannot record; launched any other way, including with --audit omitted or explicitly off, the host runner is byte-for-behaviour the runner it was at its base and records nothing; test-verified against real PostgreSQL 16 through the real Python bridge (tests/kernel-audited-host-runner-p21f.test.mjs, PR #133 with a passing CI run 33023129130) — a per-request subprocess only, no selected host server, no network listener, no release

ownerFacing.fark: Once dort P22 alt paketi mergelenmisti ama sayac 21/25'te kalmisti; simdi tek kaynak dosya + ROADMAP.md + README + CHANGELOG ayni 22/25 tamamlandi, P23/25 aktif durumunu projekte ediyor, eskimis 'deploy paketi yok, staging yok, deploy calismasi yok' iddiasinin yerini teslim edilmis deploy artefakti ile onun acikca yazilmis kalintilari aliyor ve geri kalan uretim kaniti araligi artik P23-P25.
ownerFacing.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM/HRMS form submit -> save -> reject -> retry yolculugunda artik su kanitli: paketlenmis urun imaji gercek bir PostgreSQL 16.15 yaninda ayaga kalkiyor, kendi Uvicorn dinleyicisini aciyor, gercek bir POST /customers istegi denetlenen sinirdan gecip 201 COMMITTED cevabi donuyor ve arkasinda tam olarak bir musteri satiri, bir denetim satiri ve bir outbox satiri olusuyor; yabanci bir kiracinin adina yapilan istek 403 CROSS_TENANT_DENY ile reddediliyor ve hicbir tabloya hicbir is satiri yazilmiyor. Ama bu ortam kendini siliyor: kalici bir staging ortami yok, imaj hicbir kayit defterine (registry) gonderilmiyor, disariya hicbir deploy yapilmiyor, gercek bir login/session yuzeyi yok ve secilmis kalici bir hosted sunucu yok — bu yuzden hosted gercek bir kullanici yolculugu hala calismiyor.
ownerFacing.kalanEngel: Ortam efemeral: konteynerler, veritabani birimi, ag, imaj etiketi ve gecici sir dizini kosu biter bitmez siliniyor; kalici staging ortami ve staging kosusu yok; registry yok, disariya deploy yok, uretim sunucusu secimi yok; kanit tek seferlik ve sirali, yeniden baslatma, dayaniklilik, es zamanlilik, surekli yuk ve gurultulu komsu kaniti ile izleme yok; dogrulama okumalari superuser ile yapiliyor ve RLS'i baypas ediyor, yani uygulamanin kendi okuma yolu degil; yolun hicbir yerinde kimlik dogrulama, oturum, token veya kimlik bilgisi kontrolu yok; denetim hala opt-in ve varsayilan kapali (--audit on); Docker zorunlu; digest cakmalari guvenlik guncellemelerini de donduruyor ve amd64/arm64 ayri artefaktlar; sir dosyasinin mount izinleri, rotasyonu ve depolamasi bu paketin disinda; orchestration, ingress/TLS/DNS/yuk dengeleyici, secret store, rollout/rollback tatbikati ve Actionplan writeback yok. P23-P25 (HA/DR/upgrade rollback, uc bagimsiz dis tuketici ekip kaniti, promotion gate'leri) tamamlanmadan hosted hicbir uctan uca kullanici yolculugu calismaz; deployAllowed/productionAllowed/releasableAllowed benzeri hicbir bayrak kalkmadi, hepsi false kaldi.
